purpose: Sensitivity execution that derives each outer-fold target set from development sources only and then scores the held-out laboratory source without using its target availability for selection.

outer_split.target_selection: exact intersection of rank-eligible canonical accessions in the two development sources only

models.constant: development-target mean; Spearman is undefined by contract
models.full: unpenalized-intercept ridge on the frozen sequence feature table
models.composition_only: unpenalized-intercept ridge on frozen amino-acid composition features
models.standardization: development-partition mean and standard deviation; zero standard deviation replaced by 1.0

uncertainty.low_cluster_count_policy: report every fold's batch count and do not convert source or batch counts into donor-level n

negative_control.alpha_policy: re-run nested alpha selection independently within every permutation

claim_boundary: This is an availability-aware exploratory sensitivity analysis on three redistributable paper-linked source maps. It does not establish independent biological validation, protected lockbox evaluation, no-author reproduction, external adoption or scientific submission readiness.
